name: Fresh-Food Demand Forecasting
summary: Mid-project. Nightly forecasts for 1,800 fresh items in 40 stores feed automatic supplier orders.

objective.goal: Forecast next-day demand for fresh items per store to cut waste without empty shelves
objective.deadline: Rollout to 40 stores after Ramadan review

rules.text: Client promise: order forecasts in the ERP by 11:00 every day
Never order a staple (bread, milk, laban, eggs) below last week's minimum daily sales
Ramadan and Eid forecasts must be signed off by category managers 2 weeks before
Loyalty data only aggregated per store per day; never customer-level
Nightly batch must finish by 06:00 on one 8-core CPU server (no GPU)

nodes.label: Rule: Ramadan sign-off
nodes.description: Category managers sign off 2 weeks before

nodes.label: Feature pipeline
nodes.description: Lags, Hijri calendar, salary day, promotions

nodes.label: LightGBM global model
nodes.description: WAPE 22% · trains in 2.5 h on CPU

documents.name: Promotions brief.pdf
documents.text: Tamr Markets wants a second forecasting product: predict how much extra each fresh item will sell during weekend promotions, so promotion orders are right. Forecasts must be ready every Thursday by 18:00 for the weekend. Store managers read the results in Arabic. We cannot use customer-level loyalty data.

documents.name: Kickoff notes.txt
documents.text: Marketing manager: we run about 60 promotions a month; some are supplier-funded. Supply chain manager: promotion orders go to suppliers on Thursday evening. Data team: promotions history exists for 2 years but discount depth was not recorded before 2025.
